note: Chemokine-receptor-based Th polarization on non-Tfh memory CD4 (CXCR3 × CCR6). Th1: Type-1 helper T cells (IFNγ producers; this gate also absorbs the plastic Th1/17 'Th1*' subset) — right region (CXCR3+, any CCR6). Th17_22: IL-17 / IL-22 producing Th cells — upper-left quadrant (CXCR3-, CCR6+). non_17_22_1: Th2 candidates and uncommitted effectors — lower-left quadrant (both CXCR3- and CCR6-).
tips: Chemokine-receptor-based Th polarization on non-Tfh memory CD4. Th1: CXCR3+ (any CCR6) — by this definition Th1 also absorbs CXCR3+CCR6+ (Th1/17, IFNγ+IL-17+). Th17_22: CXCR3- CCR6+. non_17_22_1: CXCR3- CCR6-. Design caveat: CXCR3+ Th1 absorbs CXCR3+CCR6+ (Th1*) events, inflating Th1 frequency vs strict CXCR3+CCR6- Th1, and propagates to the Step 9 residency analysis. To isolate Th1/17, add a 4-way CXCR3×CCR6 split. T-bet / RORγt / GATA3 not in panel — chemokine-receptor geometry carries the call. This definition matches the sister FR-FCM-Z74D_hc plan (v2) for cross-cohort comparability.
